title: Prompt ablation: does goal+schema in the system prompt convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion for M-7B-QWEN / M-3B-QWEN under the same credential-free CPU-quantized constraints as EXP-INTEL-37982024058?
question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints as the audited parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058 (identical minimal task, GBNF grammar, sampling, seeds, model artifacts and environment), does supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt — condition P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, derived from the grandparent harness SYS prompt (research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37973264582/raw/code/min_webagent.py) with the single ref->selector adaptation required by the frozen GBNF grammar — convert M-7B-QWEN's or M-3B-QWEN's step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion, where the ONLY varied dimension between treatment and comparator cells is prompts.system?
hypothesis: H1 (capability): at least one of M-7B-QWEN (evaluated first) or M-3B-QWEN clears the pre-declared capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the 5 frozen seeded episodes) under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, thereby converting the parent FALSIFIES (bounded by audit VF-01 to the underspecified prompt ceiling) into a SUPPORTS at the goal/schema protocol ceiling. H1b (attribution): for each clearing candidate, the within-experiment paired comparator cell under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED (byte-identical to the parent system prompt) fails the bar exactly as the frozen parent anchor (0/5 success, 5/5 step-1 parseable, 0/5 answer emission), identifying the goal/schema prompt as the driver (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED).
falsifier: H0: neither M-7B-QWEN nor M-3B-QWEN clears the bar under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (all treatment cells task_success_rate < 0.6), i.e., the goal/schema prompt does not convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full completion and the audited VF-01 failure mode (step-0 reveal click, re-click loop, zero answer actions) recurs under the enriched prompt. This is the Director's 'bounded negative': no credential-free factory-provisionable local CPU-quantized endpoint in the tested 3B-8B class can complete the minimal multi-step Web-agent task even with a properly specified goal/schema, so readiness condition (3) of the gated four-arm benchmark is not satisfied by this model class and the benchmark must be re-directed to hosted endpoints or a different model class. Comparator cells are expected to replicate the frozen parent result exactly; any deviation is a fail-closed replication-anchor deviation and makes the packet MEASUREMENT_INVALID (determinism means deviation = environment/protocol drift, not model behavior).

baselines.description: M-7B-QWEN under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED (byte-identical to the parent's frozen system prompt, raw/harness_config.json#prompts.system), run IN THIS EXPERIMENT through the same harness, artifacts, GBNF grammar and sampling as its treatment cell, as a paired within-packet comparator controlling for environment drift. Frozen parent anchor (audit PASS): task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5), answer_action_emission_rate=0.0.
baselines.expected_outcome: Exact replication of the parent cell: task_success_rate=0.0, parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0, answer_action_emission_rate=0.0. ANY deviation -> replication-anchor deviation -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baselines.description: M-3B-QWEN under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED; same paired-anchor logic as the 7B comparator. Frozen parent anchor: task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5), answer_action_emission_rate=0.0.
baselines.expected_outcome: Exact replication of the parent cell (0/5 success, 5/5 step-1 parseable, 0/5 answer emission); any deviation -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baselines.description: Uniform random action selection from the frozen 5-action valid space (click #reveal-btn, answer TARGET-41/42/43, unknown), 5 episodes, seeded RNG random.Random(42) created once and reused across episodes (as in the parent harness), run against the SERVED task page through the same run_episode scorer as the candidates. NOTE: the parent measured this control on an un-navigated about:blank page (its null-random mode never calls page.goto to the served port), which structurally forced click_ok=false and task_success=0; this design repairs that control-sensitivity defect by navigation. With the per-episode max of 5 steps and an answer action terminating, the success probability of any 2-action uniform draw is 1/25 (must click reveal at step 0 THEN answer TARGET-42 at step 1); the 3/5 bar (0.6) is arithmetically unreachable by chance. The deterministic seeded value is computed by the frozen driver at EXECUTE and must satisfy task_success_rate < 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 == 1.0.
baselines.expected_outcome: parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (valid JSON by construction); task_success_rate < 0.6 (deterministic seeded stream; expected 0/5 for seed 42 over the frozen 5-action space). The bar (0.6) is unreachable by chance (per-episode success probability <= 1/25).

baselines.description: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M (grandparent E-LOCAL-LLAMA). NOT re-run. Parent/grandparent evidence: emits prose with no parseable JSON action, 0/5.

Pollinations anonymous proxy (gpt-oss-20b), grandparent E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI. NOT re-run. Parent evidence: empty/reasoning-only content, ~197-token cap, intermittent HTTP 402, no SLA/pinning. Carried as the recorded fallback decision input if the local 3B-8B class yields the bounded negative.

positive_control.success_criterion: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 per evaluated cell; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 at preflight

members.protocol: 10 probes per cell (each candidate under BOTH prompt conditions): 'Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}' under the cell's own prompts.system with the frozen GBNF grammar from raw/harness_config.json.
members.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid JSON matching the action schema (positive_control_pass_rate=1.0)
members.failure_policy: a cell whose PC fails is EXCLUDED (no episodes for that cell); if both candidates' treatment-cell PCs fail -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (decoding infrastructure failure, not model capability).

members.protocol: 5/5 scripted episodes (click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42) driven through the REAL run_episode scorer against the served page by the controls driver
members.success_criterion: 5/5 task_success=true (proves the scorer registers the full completion path and the mechanical verification is live)
members.failure_policy: <5/5 -> preflight failure -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (scorer broken, not model behavior).

null_control.protocol: 5 episodes of fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') through the real scorer against the served page (navigated)
null_control.failure_policy: any parseable or successful episode -> verification logic broken -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID

measurement_validity: Only prompts.system varies between treatment and comparator cells; the task, harness code path, GBNF grammar, sampling, seeds, model artifacts and environment are identical (byte-diffed at pre-freeze: P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA == grandparent SYS with ref->selector; P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED == parent raw/harness_config.json#prompts.system byte-for-byte).

Deterministic protocol: temperature=0.0, llama_seed=42, episode seeds 42-46, max_tokens=512. Parent traces were exactly uniform across episodes (audit VF-03); the 3/5 rule is the pre-declared adequacy rule for a capability gate, not a statistical threshold, and no variance estimate is possible from the design.

Controls (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE, NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION, B-RANDOM-ACTION) run against the SERVED task page through the same run_episode scorer as the candidates (navigation repaired relative to the parent's about:blank control defect), so a positive result is registerable by the scorer and a null result cannot be an artifact of a broken navigation.

Comparator cells are collected unconditionally for every evaluated candidate BEFORE any outcome decision; each comparator cell must exactly replicate its frozen parent cell (0/5 success, 5/5 step-1 parseable, 0/5 answer action emission), else the packet is fail-closed MEASUREMENT_INVALID (replication-anchor deviation).
Positive control gates each cell: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 before that cell's episodes; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 at preflight.
Complete-cell rule: fewer than 5 completed episode records for any cell -> cell incomplete; candidate pair incomplete -> candidate skipped; both pairs incomplete -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Strict mechanical verification: Playwright DOM assertions + JSON-schema parse (identical parsing rule to parent: action must be valid JSON matching {action: click|answer, selector?: string, text?: string}); no LLM grading.

GGUF provisioning is fail-closed on digest: downloaded files must match the sha256 receipts pinned from research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37982024058/raw/gguf_sha256.txt (same model, same quantization Q4_K_M); mismatch -> provisioning_failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (not model capability).

No prompt tuning, no model substitution, no post-freeze design changes. The treatment prompt leaks neither '#reveal-btn' nor 'TARGET-42' (verified at design time), so a treatment success cannot be attributed to leakage.

The treatment prompt is the ONLY new factor relative to the parent: the parent FALSIFIES ceiling (underspecified prompt) is superseded by the goal/schema protocol ceiling exactly as the Director's bounded-negative exit requires.
decision_rule: OUTCOME in {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}; status=COMPLETE unless operational blockers preclude any cell. Cell clears iff task_success_rate >= 0.6 (>=3/5) AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 (>=3/5) over the 5 frozen seeded episodes. Precedence (first matching rule wins): (1) PREFLIGHT: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE == 5/5 AND NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION == (0.0 parseable, 0.0 success) AND B-RANDOM-ACTION == (parseable 1.0, task_success_rate < 0.6) AND all freeze_artifact hash checks match AND required stack imports OK AND GGUF digest checks PASS -> else OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (preflight failure). (2) REPLICATION-ANCHOR: any evaluated comparator cell with (task_success_rate, parseable_action_rate_step1, answer_action_emission_rate) != (0.0, 1.0, 0.0) -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (replication-anchor deviation; deterministic protocol means deviation = drift). (3) INCOMPLETE: if both candidate pairs are incomplete (fewer than 5 episode records in any evaluated cell) -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. (4) Evaluate the M-7B-QWEN pair (COMP cell: PC-JSON 10/10 then 5 episodes; TREAT cell: PC-JSON 10/10 then 5 episodes; comparator collected unconditionally). If the TREAT cell clears -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS; attribution = PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED if the COMP cell failed the bar per frozen anchor, UNDETERMINED if the COMP cell was not evaluated; STOP (M-3B-QWEN not evaluated). (5) Else evaluate the M-3B-QWEN pair identically; if its TREAT cell clears -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS with the same attribution rule; STOP. (6) Else (no TREAT cell cleared, at least one pair complete) -> OUTCOME=FALSIFIES (Director's bounded negative). report.md must record the failure-mode descriptor per candidate (answer_action_emission_rate, click loop count, step-0 reveal success) and the bounded-negative wording exactly.
product_consequence_positive: If any candidate completes click-then-answer under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA while its comparator cell replicates the parent 0/5 (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED): audit VF-01's prompt-underspecification hypothesis is confirmed as the driver of the parent failure; the parent FALSIFIES is bounded-before to the underspecified-prompt ceiling and C-LLM-INHERIT readiness condition (3) is satisfied at mechanism level (a factory-provisionable programmatic endpoint can perform a minimal multi-step Web-agent task), so the frozen four-arm benchmark (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, same model/tools/budget) becomes executable with the verified goal/schema prompt as the in-prompt task specification. C-LLM-INHERIT may advance from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL on the Director's adjudication of this bounded result.
product_consequence_negative: If no candidate clears under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (FALSIFIES = the Director's bounded negative at the prompt-ablated ceiling): the step-0-reveal re-click loop is NOT caused by missing instruction context at the 3B-8B Qwen class; the capability ceiling for credential-free CPU-quantized local models under this task/harness is real, readiness condition (3) is not satisfied by this model class, and the four-arm benchmark's credential-free path remains DESIGN_COMPROMISED. The recorded endpoint receipts (E-LOCAL-LLAMA, E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI tokens/SLA) and the re-scope set (drop Gate 3's same-model external published-baseline anchor in favor of internally re-run comparators on a dynamic-range task bank; or provision a hosted endpoint with pinning/SLA; or pursue a different model class) become decision inputs for the Global Research Director; this packet does not pre-decide the re-scope. A MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome changes no claim and requires the recorded repair before any re-run.
estimated_cost: CPU-only (nproc=4, 14 GB RAM). Up to 2 candidates x (1 comparator cell + 1 treatment cell) x (10 PC probes + up to 5 episodes x up to 5 steps) llama.cpp inferences; parent measured mean latency 5.065 s/call (7B) and 2.154 s/call (3B) at 13-17 completion tokens/call, so inference is ~15-25 min worst case (early stop after the first clearing treatment cell). Provisioning: re-download ~6.8 GB GGUFs via the confirmed huggingface.co resolve-redirect route (URLs + sha256 pinned; verified live at design time) ~20-45 min; llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 sdist build (cmake 3.31.6 + gcc 13.3 verified present) ~5-10 min; controls/preflight <5 min. No external API spend. Wall-clock estimate 45-120 min.
expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in BOTH directions: this is the cheapest measurement that separates the two competing explanations audit VF-01/U-01/U-02 left open (prompt underspecification vs model capability/planning deficit) for the exact candidate pair, at the exact frozen protocol, with a within-experiment fail-closed replication anchor. SUPPORTS unblocks the flagship four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark; FALSIFIES (bounded negative) closes the credential-free local 3B-8B path as a capability result (not a prompt artifact) and hands the Director the recorded receipts for the hosted-endpoint re-scope. This is readiness-condition-(3) work explicitly allocated by the Director (primary: agent_priors_used[2] '[a] cheap probe that separates two competing explanations... is higher decision value than another benchmark run on an unverified endpoint'), and it is NOT a census rerun or an economics claim (P2-REPLAY-COST guard applies only downstream: matched tasks and fully loaded costs before any replay/economics claim).

candidates.note: Frozen single-file URL returns 404 (parent-documented packaging deviation, raw/provisioning_evidence.json); the same-repo same-quant split shards are the pinned artifacts, digest-verified at download.
Single-file Q4_K_M; URL verified live (206 partial-range) at design time.

P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply with ONLY a valid JSON action per the schema. No prose, no reasoning, no markdown.
P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED.provenance: Byte-identical to the frozen system prompt of the audited parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058 (raw/harness_config.json#prompts.system), bound in freeze_artifacts. This is the comparator condition; its parent cell outcome (0/5) is the frozen replication anchor.

P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply ONLY with one JSON object per turn, no prose. Actions available: {"action":"click","selector":"<id>"} or {"action":"answer","text":"<code>"}. Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.
P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA.provenance: Derived from the grandparent harness SYS constant in research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37973264582/raw/code/min_webagent.py (bound in freeze_artifacts) with the single field-name adaptation ref -> selector required by the parent task grammar (the frozen GBNF admits only keys 'selector' and 'text'; a 'ref' key would decode to an unparseable action). Adds exactly the two dimensions audit VF-01 says the parent prompt lacked: (a) enumeration of the action schema and (b) the task goal sentence 'Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.' Does NOT leak '#reveal-btn' or 'TARGET-42' (verified at design time).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every outcome is arithmetically reachable and no branch shadows another. SUPPORTS requires a treatment cell >= 3/5 task_success, which the PC-ORACLE-EPISODE canary (5/5 through the real scorer, deterministic scripted actions) proves the scorer can register; the treatment cell outcome is empirically open (the whole point of the ablation). FALSIFIES requires all treatment cells < 0.6, which the parent demonstrated at identical mechanics (0/5 under the comparator prompt, result.json#metrics), and the prompt is the only changed input. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via preflight failure, replication-anchor deviation or cell incompleteness. The threshold 0.6 over 5 episodes (k>=3, k in 0..5) is fully attainable for both outcomes. Precedence 1..6 has no unreachable later rule: (4) executes only if (1)-(3) did not fire; (6) fires exactly when no treatment cell cleared and at least one pair is complete; early-stop (4) cannot shadow (2) because comparator cells are collected unconditionally before any decision. No branch is empty: with 5 seeds 42-46 per cell, each cell is a 5-element deterministic vector, and the parent already realized both extremes (0/5 and 5/5 step-1 parseable).

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is verified at DESIGN time or pinned to a frozen, previously-satisfied contract with fail-closed verification. (a) Stack assemblable in this factory: Python 3.12.15, pip 26.2.1, cmake 3.31.6 + gcc 13.3 + Python.h present (llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 builds from sdist; no wheel exists for cp312, build path verified); Chrome at /usr/bin/google-chrome (verified); playwright 1.63.0 pip-installable; CPU-only nproc=4, 14 GB RAM (parent loaded 7B split shards under these constraints). (b) GBNF grammar well-formed: all 7 rules (root, ws, action, field, string, strchars, strchar) defined and referenced (checked at design time); grammar constructible by parent-executed code. (c) Model URLs verified live at design time via the confirmed resolve-redirect route: 3B 206 (partial-range), 7B shard1 206, shard2 206, 7B single-file 404 (parent-documented packaging deviation), with sha256 pinned from raw/gguf_sha256.txt (digest mismatch -> provisioning_failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID). (d) Harness and fixture are bound repo files (freeze_artifacts) whose parsing/episode/verification logic was executed end-to-end by the audited parent; the run_episode scorer and controls semantics are inherited verbatim. (e) The serving page and Playwright flow were proven by the parent (task_episodes.json). The only EXECUTE-time creations — GGUF re-download, per-cell configs materialized from byte-exact blocks in prereg section 4.5, and the thin harness delta — are fully determined by frozen identifiers/digests and prereg text.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and comparator differ ONLY in prompts.system (P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA vs P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED, byte-diffed at design time); all other protocol dimensions — task page HTML, GBNF grammar, user template, sampling, seeds, model artifacts, harness code path — are identical, so any difference in task_success_rate / parseable_action_rate_step1 / answer_action_emission_rate between paired cells is attributable to the prompt (or to detectably-broken infrastructure, which is caught by the fail-closed anchors). The measurement range is non-degenerate: the same scorer registers 5/5 at the top (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE) and the parent produced 0/5 at the bottom under the comparator prompt; the random baseline is confined strictly below the bar (per-episode success probability <= 1/25, so P(task_success_rate >= 0.6) = 0). Cost observables (latency, tokens) are descriptive per cell and identical in kind for both arms. The P-COMP cells are not 'negative-only memories': they are re-measured in this packet, making the attribution contrast contemporaneous with the treatment.

control_sensitivity.reason: All controls run against the SERVED task page through the SAME run_episode scorer as the candidates (navigation repaired relative to the parent's about:blank control defect, which structurally zeroed the random baseline). PC-ORACLE-EPISODE (5 scripted click-then-answer episodes) fires 5/5 task_success=true, proving the positive control fires and the completion path is registerable; PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING fired 10/10 for both models in the audited parent under the identical grammar and probe, and is re-verified per cell at EXECUTE; NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION (fixed non-JSON content) stays 0/5 parseable and 0/5 success (verification rejects non-JSON); B-RANDOM-ACTION is parseable 5/5 by construction with task_success_rate < 0.6 guaranteed (per-episode success probability <= 1/25 over the frozen 5-action space), so the bar is unreachable by chance and the control cannot accidentally clear it. No control is tautological (none contains the target answer) or structurally impossible (all have non-empty, attainable expected outcomes distinct from the treatment outcome space).

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment arm is structurally live: P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA enumerates exactly the two actions admitted by the frozen GBNF grammar ('click' with 'selector', 'answer' with 'text') using the grammar's required key names (the single ref->selector adaptation was verified necessary: a 'ref' key yields an unparseable action under the parent's parser), so every grammar-feasible model output under the treatment is a parseable action that the scorer can execute — no empty or unreachable treatment sub-branch. The success path (click then answer) is registerable by the same scorer (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5). Provisioning feasibility of the exact model artifacts is verified by parent receipts and design-time URL liveness probes. The comparator cell is equally live (byte-identical to the parent prompt that produced 5/5 parseable step-1 actions with the same models). Model weights are digest-pinned and the download route is proven. The treatment does NOT leak '#reveal-btn' or 'TARGET-42', so a positive is not an artifact of answer leakage.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: Every mutable local code/data/fixture dependency whose identity could change the interpretation is listed in spec.freeze_artifacts: the parent harness runner (research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py, the audited parsing/episode/scorer logic that this design inherits), the parent fixture config template (raw/harness_config.json, probing the exact grammar/prompts/sampling), the grandparent SYS provenance (raw/code/min_webagent.py, the treatment prompt's source), the GGUF digest anchors (raw/gguf_sha256.txt) and the provisioning/packaging evidence (raw/provisioning_evidence.json) — all existing repo files, hashed at freeze time and re-verified at EXECUTE (mismatch -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID). The per-condition configs and the thin harness delta need no local file existence at freeze time: their content is frozen as byte-exact blocks inside prereg.md (section 4.5 / Appendix), and prereg.md itself is a freeze input hashed into freeze.json, so their identity is interpretation-bound before EXECUTE materializes them. Remote content (GGUFs) cannot be frozen as bytes; their URLs and sha256 digests are frozen in spec.json/prereg.md per the transmission contract, with parent receipts proving the route. No other mutable local dependencies exist.

comparative_reasoning.summary: The non-duplication check required by research/portfolio/POLICY.md: none of the 1,401 legacy artifacts concerns local CPU-quantized small-model capability probing or programmatic credential-free endpoints ('qwen', 'capability' and 'endpoint' have no material legacy hits; the historical era used hosted LLMs on Mind2Web/WebArena protocols, archived Codex section 1). Nearest legacy precedents (accepted bounded findings, not duplicates): P2-REPLAY-COST (pre2 artifact 4.114, sha 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b) — its guard ('matched tasks and fully loaded counterfactual costs before any replay/economics claim') applies to the DOWNSTREAM four-arm benchmark, not to this parse/capability probe, which makes no speedup or economics claim; P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION (pre2 artifact 4.697, sha 017a80aeb9a6759c8f6913a37031ff1616ec1bda) — composition claim, out of scope here; P2-MIND2WEB (archived Codex section 1 V0.50) — route-reconstruction claim, out of scope. This experiment is a single-factor prompt ablation that varies ONLY prompts.system while holding model/tools/budget/task fixed — strictly the READINESS-CONDITION-(3) capability gate allocated by the Director, and not a census rerun, an economics measurement, or a generality claim.
comparative_reasoning.distinct_from_siblings: EXP-INTEL-38013769440 (never froze; broadened into a capability-ceiling census with proxy/external check — rejected by design review) and EXP-INTEL-38106207218 / EXP-INTEL-38110512532 (design stage failures, never froze) are NOT used as evidence sources; this design freezes strictly the Director CONTINUE question with the paired-comparator fail-closed anchor, the navigation-repaired controls, and digest-pinned provisioning.
